name: 画像系統分析
description: Tracks the 操作 history and ancestry of images through transformation chain 分析.
algorithm: Image Phylogeny Tree Reconstruction via Pairwise Dissimilarity
mechanism: Estimates the transformation history of an image を分析することで degradation パターン. Each edit operation leaves cumulative traces that can be ordered into a phylogeny tree.
parameters: Dissimilarity: SSIM-based, Tree: minimum spanning, Features: 圧縮アーティファクト, Transform: chain
source: Dias, Z. et al. (2012) — Image Phylogeny by Minimal Spanning Trees, IEEE TIFS
useCase: 操作された可能性のある画像の編集履歴の再構築

references.title: Dias, Z. et al. (2012) — Image Phylogeny by Minimal Spanning Trees, IEEE TIFS

strengths:
• Reveals 操作 chain
• Estimates editing order
• Works with multiple transformations
• Useful for provenance tracking
limitations:
• Requires multiple image versions
• Cannot detect single-step edits
• Tree reconstruction may be ambiguous
• 計算集約的 pairwise comparison
